description: Job search: find open jobs (remote, by title, location or pay) across about 20,000 company job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Workday), crawled twice a day: about 470,000 jobs. Filter by title words, company, location, remote, minimum yearly salary and posting age. Returns up to 50 newest matches with company, location, remote flag, salary when published, posting date and link. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

minSalary.description: Minimum yearly pay, in currency; only jobs that publish pay

postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days (1-365)

title.description: Words in the job title; comma-separate alternatives (data engineer,analytics engineer)

name: jobs_search
